reproducibleBy: case index (a linear-congruential generator seeded from the index)
everyFamilyExercised: asserted - each family generates more than 100 cases, so a family that silently stopped being produced fails the test
provisionShapes: sentence chain with provisos and a cure period
definition with formula components, a percent and a ratio
line-broken reporting block with days, a period, a date and a multiplier
successCriterion: every content word of the omitted clause appears in the surfaced unaccounted text (or, for a value moved into an expansion, the region is surfaced)
